## Problem / Use Case
Describe the workflow gap or pain point you are trying to solve.

## Compatibility Notes
Jarviee keeps its core Python 3.9+ stdlib-only, runs the server strictly on `127.0.0.1`, and keeps hooks non-blocking (`exit 0`). Note any edge cases or config impact here.
